messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT · severity: P1 · control-plane-auth-service 5xx spike detected · channel #incidents · paging: oncall-eng
sre_josh: on it. digging into auth service metrics — passing to prometheus dashboard now
eng_anna: saw the alert, any recent deploys to auth in the last 30m? i left a canary earlier but it passed smoke
sre_josh: checking deploy history... none in last 45m. error pattern looks like internal 5xx from /v1/auth/validate -> DB timeouts and a downstream org-lookup 502
infra-bot: top hosts by 5xx: auth-node-12, auth-node-13, auth-node-14 · latency p95 -> 780ms · error-rate -> 9.4% (baseline 0.1%)
sre_josh: ok, priority triage: 1) mitigate customer impact 2) identify root cause 3) rollback or config fix
support_lina: getting customer reports: two customers seeing failures on token refresh and user lookup — CS is collecting request ids
prod-ops: spinning up extra auth replicas in us-west-2 now, scaling from 10 -> 20
eng_anna: can we enable the read-only cached org-lookup fallback for 15m? That should reduce org lookup failures
sre_josh: yes, feature-flagging fallback now
sre_josh: toggled flag: org_lookup_fallback=enabled
eng_anna: patch diff I applied to flagger:
```
- org_lookup_strict: true
+ org_lookup_strict: false
+ org_lookup_fallback: enabled
```
sre_josh: quick check of logs on auth-node-12
```
[2026-03-14T15:03:12Z] ERROR auth: db.conn_timeout: timeout waiting for connection pool
[2026-03-14T15:03:12Z] ERROR auth: downstream org-lookup 502 (timeout)
```
infra-bot: DB connection pool utilization: 98% on auth-db-proxy · max_conns 200 · waiting queue rising
sre_josh: looks like auth svc exhausting DB pool under a burst. two options: increase pool, or circuit-break to cached lookup. already enabled cached fallback.
prod-ops: increased DB proxy max_conns from 200 -> 400 (patched live)
eng_anna: marking this as a mitigation step: increased DB pool and enabled fallback. monitoring for error-rate drop
sre_josh: error-rate dropping on node-12 after pool change — 5xx down from 9.4% -> 1.1% in 2m
support_lina: CS: informing affected customers — telling them we have a rollback-free mitigation in place and monitoring. collecting any remaining failed request IDs.
prod-ops: also added iptables throttle on node-14 to drain connections for safe restart
sre_josh: restarting auth-node-14 to clear stuck connections
eng_anna: restart complete. node rejoined healthy pool
infra-bot: metrics summary: 5xx -> 0.22% overall; latency p95 -> 210ms
sre_josh: good. declare immediate customer impact reduced to limited and intermittent. we'll keep P1 until fully stable for 30m
support_lina: creating a customer-facing incident note (short) and sending to CS and account owners
support_lina: public note draft: "We've observed elevated token validation errors due to an auth service dependency. We've enabled a cached fallback and increased DB pool sizes; service is recovering. We're continuing to monitor and will follow up with a postmortem."
prod-ops: oncall handoff — i'm staying on for 15m then handing to @sre_josh-next
sre_josh: thanks. i'll take point for the postmortem. immediate action items: 1) verify DB proxy config persists across deploys 2) add circuit-breaker for DB saturation 3) add synthetic token-refresh checks to our SLO tests
eng_anna: already opened task INF-3982 for persistent DB proxy change and INF-3983 for circuit-breaker
sre_josh: capturing timeline in incident doc. linking logs and graphs: https://grafana.company.internal/d/abc/auth-spike?from=now-1h
support_lina: CS requests ETA for full resolution to share with customers
sre_josh: ETA: monitoring for 30m stabilization window; if stable, we'll set to resolved and run postmortem
infra-bot: scheduled autoscaler adjustment: min_replicas for auth -> 12 for next 6h to prevent future cold spikes
eng_anna: note: we should also check billing/config-service for similar connection pool settings — these control plane deps often share the same proxy
sre_josh: agreed. pinging @prod-ops to run a quick scan on other services
prod-ops: scanning config-services... billing-service pool at 75% utilization, config-service at 92% (warning). opening ops ticket to align settings
sre_josh: final: P1->P2 tentative if metrics hold. leaving thread for handoff updates. thanks all :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: Incident update · status: mitigated -> monitoring · severity: P2 · updated by sre_josh · link: #incidents/1772000123
sre_josh: handing off to @sre_josh-next for overnight monitoring at 15:45 UTC — please acknowledge
sre_josh-next: acked. i'll monitor dashboards and intervene if error_rate > 1% sustained
